title: What If You Could Pause Time?

lines.text: What if you could pause time?
One snap... and the whole world just stops.
Birds freeze in mid-air. Raindrops hang like tiny glass beads.
You could walk into any bakery, eat everything, and nobody would ever know.
Sounds amazing, right? But there's one problem nobody thinks about.
You only see things because light bounces off them and flies into your eyes.
Pause time, and that light stops too. Frozen, halfway to you.
So the second you snap... everything goes pitch black.
And the air? Every single air molecule is frozen in place.
Taking one step would feel like walking into solid concrete.
No light. No sound. You can't even move your fingers...
So... would you still press pause?
